name: ZUGFeRD / Factur-X (German e-invoice)
description: Embeds a CrossIndustryInvoice XML payload into Compose-rendered PDFs, producing a PDF/A-3 hybrid that German accounting software (DATEV, Lexware, sevDesk) can ingest automatically. Required for B2B invoices in Germany 2025–2027. Templates opt in via `"zugferd": true` + an `invoice_fields` mapping; templates without those flags render plain PDFs untouched.
author: yorik-core
